```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from rlberry.envs.bandits import BernoulliBandit
from rlberry.agents.bandits import (
    UCBAgent,
    UCBVAgent,
    ETCAgent,
    MOSSAgent,
    IMEDAgent,
    NPTSAgent,
    EXP3Agent,
)
from rlberry.wrappers import WriterWrapper
from rlberry.manager import ExperimentManager

# Set random seed for reproducibility
SEED = 42
np.random.seed(SEED)

# Problem parameters
n_arms = 5
arm_means = [0.1, 0.5, 0.7, 0.3, 0.9]
T = 1000

# Create bandit environment
def make_env():
    return BernoulliBandit(arm_means, seed=SEED)

# Agent configs
agent_classes = {
    "UCB": UCBAgent,
    "UCBV": UCBVAgent,
    "ETC": ETCAgent,
    "MOSS": MOSSAgent,
    "IMED": IMEDAgent,
    "NPTS": NPTSAgent,
    "EXP3": EXP3Agent,
}

agent_kwargs = {
    "UCB": dict(burn_in=1),
    "UCBV": dict(burn_in=1),
    "ETC": dict(burn_in=1),
    "MOSS": dict(burn_in=1),
    "IMED": dict(burn_in=1),
    "NPTS": dict(burn_in=1),
    "EXP3": dict(gamma=0.07),
}

# Experiment managers for each agent
managers = []
for name, agent_class in agent_classes.items():
    agent_kwargs_ = agent_kwargs.get(name, {})
    manager = ExperimentManager(
        agent_class,
        (make_env,),
        agent_kwargs=agent_kwargs_,
        fit_budget=T,
        n_fit=1,
        seed=SEED,
        wrappers=[WriterWrapper],
        init_kwargs={},
        output_dir=None,
        enable_tensorboard=False,
        name=name,
    )
    managers.append(manager)

# Train all agents
for manager in managers:
    manager.fit()

# Collect data
results = {}
optimal_mean = max(arm_means)
for manager in managers:
    name = manager.name
    writer_data = manager.get_writer_data()
    actions = np.array(writer_data["action"])
    rewards = np.array(writer_data["reward"])
    times = np.arange(1, len(rewards) + 1)
    # Cumulative regret
    optimal_rewards = optimal_mean * np.ones_like(rewards)
    regret = np.cumsum(optimal_rewards - rewards)
    # Cumulative pseudo-regret
    arm_counts = np.array([np.cumsum(actions == a) for a in range(n_arms)])
    pseudo_regret = np.cumsum([optimal_mean - arm_means[a] for a in actions])
    # Arm pulls
    arm_pulls = np.array([(actions == a).sum() for a in range(n_arms)])
    results[name] = {
        "actions": actions,
        "rewards": rewards,
        "regret": regret,
        "pseudo_regret": pseudo_regret,
        "arm_pulls": arm_pulls,
        "times": times,
    }

# Plotting styles
linestyles = [
    "-",
    "--",
    "-.",
    ":",
    (0, (3, 1, 1, 1)),
    (0, (5, 5)),
    (0, (1, 10)),
]
colors = sns.color_palette("tab10", n_colors=len(agent_classes))

# Plot cumulative pseudo-regret
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
for idx, (name, res) in enumerate(results.items()):
    plt.plot(
        res["times"],
        res["pseudo_regret"],
        label=name,
        linestyle=linestyles[idx % len(linestyles)],
        color=colors[idx],
        linewidth=2,
    )
plt.xlabel("Time")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Pseudo-Regret")
plt.title("Cumulative Pseudo-Regret")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Plot cumulative regret
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
for idx, (name, res) in enumerate(results.items()):
    plt.plot(
        res["times"],
        res["regret"],
        label=name,
        linestyle=linestyles[idx % len(linestyles)],
        color=colors[idx],
        linewidth=2,
    )
plt.xlabel("Time")
plt.ylabel("Cumulative Regret")
plt.title("Cumulative Regret")
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Plot number of times each arm was selected
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
bar_width = 0.1
indices = np.arange(n_arms)
for idx, (name, res) in enumerate(results.items()):
    plt.bar(
        indices + idx * bar_width,
        res["arm_pulls"],
        width=bar_width,
        label=name,
        color=colors[idx],
        alpha=0.8,
    )
plt.xlabel("Arm")
plt.ylabel("Number of Pulls")
plt.title("Number of Times Each Arm Was Selected")
plt.xticks(indices + bar_width * (len(agent_classes) - 1) / 2, [f"Arm {i}" for i in range(n_arms)])
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
